Profiles, preferences and itinerary snapshots are saved on this device. Live planning sends profile city, currency and travel preferences to your configured server. Planning conversations and generated trips are also stored there under an anonymous session. Clearing app data loses local snapshots and that server identity; it does not delete server records.
